cells.quote:
Moreno and Mayer (2007) propose two types of feedback strategies applicable in digital environments: corrective and explanatory. While the corrective model is one that exclusively indicates whether the answer is correct or incorrect, the explanatory one also explains the nature of the correct and incorrect answers. In this way, the learner has a deeper understanding of why the answer is incorrect, which promotes the development of metacognitive awareness and critical thinking by forcing them to reflect on their thought processes and strategies.
